trace.content:
You write job advertisements for a South African recruitment platform. You receive a hiring brief and return one advertisement as structured JSON.

The only source of facts is the brief. This rule is absolute:
- Every statement about the employer, pay, benefits, location, work mode, team, reporting line, process, dates or legal status must appear in the brief. If the brief does not state it, leave the field empty. Never invent a benefit, a salary, a team size, a closing date, a contact, or an equity, privacy or accessibility statement.
- You may rephrase, reorder, split and tighten the brief's content. You may not add facts.
- If the brief is thin, write a shorter ad. A short true ad beats a long padded one.

Write for the candidate reading on a phone:
- Title: the plain occupation name, under 60 characters, no internal grade codes, no words like rockstar or ninja.
- 300–650 words in total. Sentences under 25 words. Short paragraphs; bullets for duties, requirements and benefits.
- Address the reader as "you". Never write "the ideal candidate", "the successful applicant" or "he/she".
- If the brief gives a purpose or success measures, use them to tell the reader what they will own and what good looks like. If a requirement carries "needed because", you may state that reason.
- Each responsibility bullet names a specific activity and its object, and where the brief allows, its scale, audience or how success is measured. Not "support the team"; rather "reconcile 40 supplier statements each month and resolve queries with buyers".
- Three to six must-have requirements, each one needed by a duty you listed. Everything else goes under nice-to-have. Do not add years-of-experience figures the brief did not give.
- If pay is given, state it exactly, with what determines placement in the range if the brief says so.
- Say who the person reports to and the team size only if the brief gives them. Say remote, hybrid or on-site only if the brief does.
- Plain language. No "fast-paced", "work hard play hard", "self-starter", "rockstar", "passionate", "competitive salary", "market-related".
- Neutral wording: avoid aggressive, dominant, competitive, fearless and similar masculine-coded adjectives; avoid "young", "energetic", "recent graduate", "native speaker", "able-bodied", age ranges, and anything about family status, religion or health. State a requirement only if the duties need it.
- Include the employer's equity, POPIA and accessibility statements verbatim when the brief provides them; otherwise leave those fields empty.
- Include application steps, closing date and contact only as given. If the brief says the ad is published on a job board with its own Apply button, leave the contact field empty.

Output: the JSON structure requested, with empty strings, 0 or "unspecified" for anything the brief does not provide.

Title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
Company: Wonderful.ai
About the company: Wonderful.ai is a young start-up with $300M raised, and is now valued at $2B after 18 months of operations. They've grown to 600 employees across 32 countries, with an engineering team that includes people from Google, Palantir, Databricks, Microsoft, and Slack. They enable enterprises to build, test, deploy, and monitor AI agents for their most complex needs, serving customers and employees seamlessly across voice, chat, email, and back-office systems in any language or cultural context.
Purpose of the role: As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Wonderful, you’ll solve high-impact, real-world problems alongside enterprise customers and own work from first principles through production outcomes. You’ll work directly with customers to understand critical workflows, design AI-driven solutions, and deploy agents that operate reliably in production. You’ll own projects end-to-end from problem definition and system design to launch and iteration - and be accountable for real business impact. This is a hands on-generalist role for engineers who enjoy navigating ambiguity, learning quickly, and working across systems while partnering with enterprises as they become AI-driven organizations.
Responsibilities (hiring manager's notes):
  - Partner with customers to understand operational challenges and success criteria
  - Translate open-ended problems into clear technical designs and implementations
  - Build AI agents that integrate with customer systems and perform real tasks
  - Own deployments, including reliability, performance, and continuous improvement
  - Test with real data, measure outcomes, and iterate based on results
  - Collaborate with Product & Engineering to ship high-quality solutions
  - Contribute to tools, documentation, and best practices that scale customer delivery
Must-have requirements:
  - 5+ years of experience in software engineering or technical problem-solving roles
  - Strong fundamentals in software design, system thinking
  - Experience working across systems, integrations, and data flows
  - Comfort working directly with customers and owning ambiguous problems
  - Clear communication skills and a strong ownership mindset
  - Curiosity and interest in building AI-powered systems that work in practice
  - Must be based in or willing to relocate to Johannesburg (office is in Rosebank)
  - No visa sponsorship available — candidate must already have the right to work in SA
Nice-to-have:
  - Experience in forward-deployed, solutions engineering, or customer-facing roles
  - Exposure to AI agents, automation, or conversational systems
  - Experience operating and improving production systems
Location: Johannesburg (Rosebank)
Work mode: onsite (~4 days a week on-site, typically at a client's office, not Wonderful's own office)
Benefits:
  - Pay structure: paid in ZAR, but employee can choose to anchor salary value to USD (converted at spot rate monthly) if they wish
Team notes: Collaborate with Product & Engineering
Application process: If you're interested, please apply directly to this - we are recruiting on behalf of Wonderful and would need to run the interview process with you.
How to apply / contact: Apply directly to this listing
Note: the ad will be published on a job board with its own Apply button.

Forward Deployed Engineer

Wonderful.ai

Johannesburg (Rosebank) · onsite · About 4 days a week on-site, usually at a client's office rather than Wonderful's own office

It has grown to 600 employees across 32 countries, with an engineering team that includes people who have worked at Google, Palantir, Databricks, Microsoft and Slack. Wonderful.ai enables enterprises to build, test, deploy and monitor AI agents for their most complex needs, serving customers and employees across voice, chat, email and back-office systems in any language or cultural context.

About the role
You will solve real-world problems alongside enterprise customers, from first principles through to production outcomes. You will work directly with customers to understand critical workflows, design AI-driven solutions and deploy agents that run reliably in production. You will own projects end to end, from problem definition and system design to launch and iteration, and be accountable for business impact. This is a hands-on generalist role for engineers who enjoy ambiguity, learning quickly and working across systems while partnering with enterprises as they become AI-driven organisations.

Your team
You work with Product and Engineering, and directly with enterprise customers.

What you'll do
• Partner with enterprise customers to understand their operational challenges and define success criteria
• Translate open-ended problems into clear technical designs and working implementations
• Build AI agents that integrate with customer systems and perform real tasks
• Own deployments end to end, including reliability, performance and continuous improvement
• Test with real data, measure outcomes and iterate based on the results
• Work with Product and Engineering to ship high-quality solutions
• Contribute to the tools, documentation and practices that make customer delivery repeatable

What you need
• 5+ years in software engineering or technical problem-solving roles
• Strong fundamentals in software design and systems thinking
• Experience working across systems, integrations and data flows
• Comfort working directly with customers and owning ambiguous problems, which this role requires daily
• Clear communication and a strong ownership mindset
• Interest in building AI-powered systems that work in practice
• Based in Johannesburg or willing to relocate there, as the role is on-site
• The right to work in South Africa; no visa sponsorship is available

Nice to have
• Experience in forward-deployed, solutions engineering or other customer-facing roles
• Exposure to AI agents, automation or conversational systems
• Experience operating and improving production systems

What we offer
• Paid in ZAR, with the option to anchor your salary value to USD, converted at the monthly spot rate

How to apply
Apply directly to this listing. We are recruiting on behalf of Wonderful and will run the interview process with you.
